text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — we have an SDE candidate (Aisha K.) on Thu 3:00pm PST. Need 2 interviewers + scribe and confirmation that recording/notes consent is captured. React :eyes: if you can make it, :x: if you can't.
Anna: :eyes: I can take an interviewer slot (system design).
Devin: I can be scribe unless someone else wants it.
Samir: I’ll take coding — 3pm PST works for me.
Elena: Sorry I’m out that slot, conflict with on-call.
Jordan: I can cover if needed. What’s our rubric split for this loop?
Priya: Rubric: design 40%, coding 35%, collaboration/culture 25%. Use 1-4 scale (4 = strong hire). Debrief order: scribe first, then interviewers, then hiring manager. Please capture 1–2 bullets per section.
Devin: Quick Q — do we normalize across interviewers or average raw scores?
Priya: Average raw scores; we only normalize in exceptional situations. Add a short sentence if you adjust.
recruitbot: Candidate profile note: "Aisha K. — 6 yrs backend, 2 yrs infra; consent to recording received via form on file."
Anna: Can someone drop the calendar invite + zoom link here?
Priya: Invite sent and updated with Zoom: https://zoom.company/meet/abc123 — calendar event includes rubric template.
Jordan: Thanks — I’ll prep 2 design follow-ups and a coding task.
Samir: Noted, will prepare 1 coding prompt and an edge-case question for scale.
Devin: I’ll take scribe and capture bullets in the template, + timestamped notes.
Priya: Awesome — final ask: if you can’t make it, post swaps here 24h in advance. Otherwise we’re set. :thumbsup:
